input.quote: (a) This Agreement is governed in all respects by the laws of the State of Delaware without giving effect to its conflict of laws principles. Each Party hereby irrevocably submits for all disputes to the exclusive jurisdiction and venue of the state and federal courts located in New York, New York.
input.rationale: Section 14(a) selects Delaware law but a New York, New York exclusive forum. Delaware law is only an acceptable fallback and the playbook fallback pairs Delaware law with Delaware courts; the preferred position (New York law with the state and federal courts in New York County) is reached with a one-word change to the jurisdiction words, leaving the agreed forum intact. Venue is court-based rather than foreign arbitration, so no walk-away issue arises, although Section 8's mandatory AAA arbitration (no foreign seat specified) conflicts with the exclusive court jurisdiction and is flagged in the comment for conforming.

proposal.summary: Change governing law from Delaware to New York to match the New York County forum
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law from Delaware to New York so that the substantive law matches the agreed exclusive New York, New York forum; our position is New York law with the state and federal courts in New York County. If Delaware law is important to you, we can accept Delaware law and Delaware courts instead, but we would then need Section 8 conformed so disputes go to the courts rather than mandatory arbitration.
